prompt: Opening the bag preview from the header feels sluggish on category pages with many products. Nothing on the product cards changes, but the profiler shows every price re-rendering. Find out why and stop it.

truth.cause: ShopProviders owns the bag-preview open state and passes LocaleContext a new object literal on every render, so toggling the drawer gives every useLocale consumer (each Price) a new context value with equal contents.
truth.summary: Memoise the locale context value on locale, formatPrice and setLocale so unrelated provider state does not re-render its consumers.

referenceFix.find: <LocaleContext value={{ locale, currency: currencyFor(locale), formatPrice, setLocale }}>
